items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Walter. Walter Delarue was playing sax. I was playing the piano.

ctx.x: I think we did and then we might as well do it again. We might as well do it again just to make sure. You said you had a saxophone player there with you. Delarue.

Walter. Walter Delarue was playing sax. I was playing the piano. And George Augustine, that's who was playing guitar there. The same George Augustine I was playing guitar, and Rennie playing trumpet. What year was that?
